sql: SELECT regexp_extract(r.abstractText, '([^.]*1092[^.]*)', 1) AS sentence FROM papers LATERAL VIEW explode(resultList.result) AS r WHERE r.pmid = '30342298' AND r.abstractText LIKE '%1092%' LIMIT 5
rows: This event-driven study will complete when 1092 adjudicated primary endpoints have accrued with at least 200 occurring in women
